transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... I guess I'm here because... well, people have been pointing some things out. They say they can see me moving like I'm underwater. Like it takes me forever to just answer a question or... get up out of a chair. 

And if I'm not doing that, I'm just pacing around my apartment. Rubbing my hands together, kind of like I'm trying to shake off a bad call from work. So... yeah. That's why I came in.
Do you have thoughts that keep repeating in your mind and are hard to get rid of?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, nothing like that. Just the usual stuff, I guess. Nothing that gets stuck.
Do you feel anxious or on edge most of the time?
No. Um... not really. Just the normal amount, I guess. I wouldn't say I'm on edge all the time or anything.
Have you been feeling sad or depressed lately?
Um... no, not really. I mean, I don't think so. Just... normal, I guess. Nothing out of the ordinary.
Do you feel like you're moving slowly or quickly compared to how you normally move?

Um... I guess people have said something about it. Like... they can see me moving like I'm underwater, or taking forever to answer or just get out of a chair. And then... other times I guess I just pace around my apartment. Rubbing my hands. Kind of like I'm trying to shake off a bad customer call. So... yeah, I guess.
Have you ever had a period of time where you felt abnormally happy or irritable?
Um... no. I don't think so. I mean, not abnormally. Just... regular, I guess. I haven't really noticed anything like that.
Do you have any repetitive behaviors that you feel compelled to do?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think I do anything like that. Just... I don't know, normal habits, I guess. Nothing I feel like I have to do.
Have you ever felt extremely happy or overly energetic for a long time?
Um... no. I think... didn't you just ask something like that? But no. I don't really get extremely happy or... full of energy. Just... no. Never really happened.
Have you experienced any traumatic or very stressful events recently?
Um... no. Not really. Just... the usual stuff, I guess. Nothing... nothing major stands out.
Have you ever had a period where you felt extremely energetic and didn't need much sleep?
Um... no. I think... didn't we just talk about the energy thing? But no. I don't... I definitely need my sleep. I never stay up like that.
Have you noticed any changes in your interest in activities you normally enjoy?

Um... yeah. I guess. I used to do a few things... sketching, keeping notes on coffee... weekend hikes. They used to make me feel like myself, but... lately, I don't know. I'll open the notebook or... lace up my boots, and... I just feel nothing pulling me toward it. So... yeah.
Do you often feel guilty about things?

Um... yeah, I guess. I just... I keep thinking about work. Like, little things. I'll replay these small mistakes from my customer service job, or... or my contract stuff. And I just feel like... like if I send one slow reply, I've let everyone down. Like I probably deserve to be fired over it. So... yeah, I guess I do.
Do you find that you are no longer able to enjoy things that you used to find pleasurable?
Um... isn't that... didn't we just go over that? With the sketching and stuff? I just... yeah. Like I said, I don't really get anything out of it right now.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?

Um... I'm not really sure about significant, but... yeah, I guess my jeans have been a bit looser lately. I just... most days I forget to eat until the late afternoon. And then cooking just feels like... too much. So I usually just grab some toast or cereal or something. But um... yeah.
Do you think your guilt feelings are worse than what most people would feel in the same situations?

Um... I mean... maybe? I don't know what other people feel. I just... like I said before, I just keep thinking about those little mistakes at work. Or with the contract stuff. It just feels like... if I'm slow to reply, I've ruined it for everyone. Like I should just be fired. I don't know if that's worse than normal... it's just how it is.
Have you ever heard voices or seen things that aren't there?

Um... I don't know about seeing things. But... sometimes I hear stuff. Just... little things. Like, I'll hear the beep from my old work headset. Or... a voice that sounds like one of my supervisors. It'll just say my name, or tell me I'm being too slow. But... my laptop will be closed, and my phone isn't even ringing. So... yeah. I don't really know why that happens.
Do you think the voices you hear are real?
Um... I mean, I know my laptop is closed. So... they can't be real. But... they sound real when I hear them. So... I'm not really sure.
Have the voices you hear ever told you to do something?
No. Um... no, they don't do that. It's just... just the things I said. Nothing else.
Have you ever had a period where these voices stopped for a while?

Um... well, not really. I mean, there were a couple of weeks... maybe a month ago, where I felt... okay. Like, my mood was better, and I was actually getting stuff done around the house. But... I still heard the voice then. Or... I'd just get this really strong feeling that the old ticketing system from work was flagging me for being too slow. Even when I was feeling better, that stuff didn't really stop.
Have you ever had a period where you didn't hear the voices for more than a few days?
No, not really. They're... they're just always there.
